title: Part Time Website Content Coordinator
description:
Website Content Coordinator

Location: Coventry CV4 and home working

Salary: £17,000 to £18,900 pro rata actual (Up to £33,000 FTE)

Hours: Part-time, 20 hours per week flexible

Contract: 9-month fixed-term contract

Benefits: Excellent holiday entitlement, contributory pension scheme, onsite parking and employee assistance programme

We are working on behalf of esteemed organisation, who are recruiting a creative and user-focused Website Content Coordinator to support one of the organisation's most significant digital transformation projects. This is an exciting opportunity to play a leading role in reviewing, rewriting and creating engaging website content that ensures their audience can find information quickly, access services easily and connect with everything the organisation has to offer.

As Website Content Coordinator, you will work in a small Communications & Marketing team, reporting into the Communications & Marketing Coordinator and working closely with the Communications & Marketing Director. You will also collaborate with colleagues across the organisation and the website project team to ensure content is clear, accessible, accurate and aligned with user needs, research insights and Warwick SU's brand.

The role is part-time at 20 hours per week. There are no fixed working days: the employer is happy to be flexible depending on the successful candidate and their needs, including considering shorter working days across the week. The business has a hybrid working policy with flexibility to work from home dependent on operational requirements.

This is a 9-month fixed-term contract based on the budget currently available for this project role.

Role and responsibilities:
- As a Website Content Coordinator, you will lead the audit, review and redevelopment of website content across the organisation, ensuring content is relevant, engaging and meets user needs.
- Write, edit and proofread high-quality website copy that reflects the organisations tone of voice, brand values and accessibility standards.
- Work closely with colleagues across the organisation to gather information, understand services and translate complex information into clear, student-friendly content.
- Apply user research, content strategy and digital best practice to improve website usability, navigation and overall user experience.
- Collaborate with the website project team to ensure content aligns with the new website structure, design, user journeys and project milestones.
- Support content migration, quality assurance and population of the new website using the content management system.
- Contribute to content governance processes, editorial standards and sustainable workflows that support long-term website maintenance.
- Build positive relationships across departments and help ensure website content remains accurate, relevant and up to date.

Skills and experience required:
- Demonstrable experience writing, editing and proofreading content for websites or other digital channels.
- Experience managing complex content projects involving multiple stakeholders.
- Experience gathering information from subject matter experts and translating it into engaging content for target audiences.
- Experience reviewing and improving content for usability, readability and accessibility.
- Exceptional written communication and copywriting skills, with excellent attention to detail.
- Strong organisational skills with the ability to manage multiple projects and competing deadlines.
- Strong relationship-building and stakeholder management skills, with the confidence to work collaboratively across an organisation.
- Understanding of digital content best practice, including accessibility and user-centred content design.
- Proactive, self-motivated and able to work independently, with a curious and analytical approach to understanding user needs.
- Experience of website redevelopment or digital transformation projects and familiarity with content management systems would be advantageous.

Benefits:
- Pro rota holiday entitlement based on 22 days annual leave including Bank Holidays and additional closure days
- Enhanced pension scheme
- Wellbeing programme
- Onsite parking
- BUPA cash plan
- Employee assistance programme

Interviews are scheduled for week commencing 21st and 28th September 2026.

If you are looking for a creative digital content role where you can make an impact, then please apply for this Website Content Coordinator opportunity.

title: Receptionist
description: PLEASE NOTE THE HOURS REQUIRED FOR THIS ROLE ARE 13:30 - 18:30 Monday to Friday. We are seeking a professional and friendly Receptionist to join our team. The ideal candidate will be the first point of contact for our patients and visitors, providing exceptional customer service while managing various tasks. This role is essential in ensuring the smooth operation of our GP Practice. Maintaining and monitoring the Practice appointments system Processing personal requests for appointments, visits and telephone consultations and ensuring callers are directed to the appropriate healthcare professional. Processing and distributing incoming and outgoing mail. Explaining practice arrangements and formal requirements to new patients and those seeking temporary cover and ensure procedures are completed. Receiving and making telephone calls as required. Divert calls and take messages, ensuring accuracy of detail and prompt appropriate delivery. Processing prescriptions in accordance with practice guidelines Computer data entry/data allocation and collation; processing and recording information in accordance with Practice procedures. Initiating contact with and responding to requests from patients, other team members and associated healthcare agencies and providers Advise patients of relevant charges for private (non-General Medical Services), accept payment and issue receipts. Clearing and re-stocking consulting rooms as required. Providing administrative support to the Practice as required, including filing, photocopying and scanning. Keeping the reception area, noticeboards, and leaflet dispensers tidy and free from obstructions and clutter Providing cover for reception / administrative colleagues during absence due to holiday or sick leave. Maintaining and monitoring the practice appointment system Process personal, telephone and e-requests for appointments. Answer incoming phone calls, transferring calls or dealing with the callers request appropriately. Signpost patients to the correct service. Input data into the patients healthcare records, as necessary. Direct requests for information i.e. SAR, insurance / solicitors letters, and DVLA forms to the administrative team Support in the management of repeat prescriptions, ensuring they are processed accurately and efficiently. Process repeat prescription requests received by any means of communication in accordance with practice protocol. Ensure all prescription requests are processed and are ready for collection within the required and expected timeframe. Generate requests for medication on behalf of the patient for non-repeat items. Discuss with patients their requirements, encouraging patients to order only what they require. Act upon compliance issues, liaising with the appropriate clinician. Ensure medication reviews are arranged by maintaining an accurate recall system. Effectively liaise with external services, i.e., district nurses, to ensure medicaments are arranged for housebound patients. Initiate contact with and respond to, requests from patients, team members, and external agencies. Manage all queries as necessary in an efficient manner. Act as a chaperone as required. Be aware of your duties and responsibilities regarding current legislation and adhere to practice policies and procedures on Safeguarding Adults and Safeguarding Children Attend a formal appraisal with their manager at least every 12 months. Once a performance/training objective has been set, progress will be reviewed on a regular basis so that new objectives can be agreed. Undertake all mandatory training and induction programmes deemed suitable by the Practice Manager / Partners. Be an integral part of the general practice team. Support all clinical staff with general tasks as requested. Maintain a clean, tidy, effective working area at all times. Providing administrative support to the Practice as required, including filing, photocopying, scanning, culling of notes. Support reception staff, providing cover during staff absences. Scanning of patient related documentation and attaching scanned documents to patients healthcare records Complete opening and closing procedures in accordance with the duty rota. Support administrative staff, providing cover during staff absences. Participate in local initiatives to enhance service delivery and patient care. Support the Operations Manager in reviewing and updating the Prescribing Policy and SOPs Any other duties commensurate with this position
